title: Cheesy Broccoli, Feta and Garlic Calzones
changes_from_base: Garlicky chopped broccoli with a mix of mozzarella and crumbled feta replaces the spinach and ricotta filling, and two large calzones are baked on oiled trays rather than served with a tomato dip.
summary: Two stuffed pizza pastries packed with tender broccoli, creamy feta and melted mozzarella.
equipment: large frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about ½ tsp, for the broccoli's cooking water

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about ¼ tsp, for the filling

ingredients.item: pizza dough (2 balls of 450 g), shop-bought or homemade

steps.title: Prepare oven
steps.text: Set the oven to 245 °C with shelves positioned in both the upper and lower middle, and brush each baking tray with 1½ tsp of olive oil.

steps.title: Mix cheese
steps.text: Stir the grated mozzarella and crumbled feta together in a small bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Cook broccoli
steps.text: Bring 240 ml water and ½ tsp salt to the boil in the frying pan, add the frozen broccoli florets, cover with a lid and simmer for 3–5 min until just tender, then drain very thoroughly and chop into rough pieces.

steps.title: Finish vegetables
steps.text: Dry out the pan, add the remaining olive oil and the finely chopped garlic, cook over medium heat for about 1 min until the aroma fills the kitchen, then add the chopped broccoli back in along with the remaining salt and the ground black pepper.

steps.title: Roll dough
steps.text: On a floured work surface, roll each 450 g ball of pizza dough into a 30 cm circle and place one on each oiled tray.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Pile half the mixed cheeses over one half of each dough round, leaving a 2–3 cm clear border, then pile half the garlic broccoli on top.

steps.title: Seal and slash
steps.text: Wet the edges of the dough with water, fold the dough over to enclose the filling, press firmly along the sealed edge, then cut 5 diagonal slits across the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 15–20 min until deep golden, swapping the positions of the trays halfway through if one is browning much faster than the other.

tips: Drain the broccoli in a colander and squeeze it gently in a clean tea towel to remove as much moisture as possible—this keeps the pastry base crisp.
Use fresh garlic that you've finely chopped rather than minced from a jar, which has a sharper, harsher flavour.
Stagger the trays so one sits higher than the other; halfway through, swap them so both brown evenly.
storage: Serve warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
